Full marks may be obtained for answers to ALL questions. Mathematical formulae booklets published by the Board are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving the answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. Start each question on a fresh page.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Two variables $X$ and $Y$ are related by an equation of the form $Y = \log_{10}(mX + c)$. The table below gives the corresponding values of $X$ and $Y$.

| $X$ | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $Y$ | 0.857 | 0.924 | 0.982 | 1.033 | 1.079 | 1.121 |

(a) Draw a linear graph by plotting values of $10^Y$ against $X$.

(b) Use your graph to estimate, to the nearest whole number, the values of $m$ and $c$. (8 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Reduction to linear form.** Taking antilogarithms (base 10) of $Y = \log_{10}(mX + c)$ gives

$$10^{Y} = mX + c.$$

This is a straight line when $10^Y$ is plotted on the vertical axis against $X$ on the horizontal axis: the **gradient is $m$** and the **intercept on the $10^Y$ axis (at $X = 0$) is $c$**.

**(a) Table of values** (calculator, $10^Y$ to 2 decimal places):

| $X$ | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $Y$ | 0.857 | 0.924 | 0.982 | 1.033 | 1.079 | 1.121 |
| $10^Y$ | 7.19 | 8.39 | 9.59 | 10.79 | 11.99 | 13.21 |

For example $10^{0.857} = 7.194$, $10^{0.924} = 8.395$, $10^{0.982} = 9.594$, $10^{1.033} = 10.789$, $10^{1.079} = 11.995$, $10^{1.121} = 13.213$.

*The graph to draw.* Use the $X$ axis from $0$ to $6$ (for example 2 cm per unit) and the vertical axis from $0$ to $14$ (for example 1 cm per unit), so that the intercept at $X = 0$ can be read. Plot the six points $(1,\,7.19)$, $(2,\,8.39)$, $(3,\,9.59)$, $(4,\,10.79)$, $(5,\,11.99)$, $(6,\,13.21)$. They lie on a straight line (each increase of $1$ in $X$ raises $10^Y$ by about $1.2$). Draw the best-fit line through them and extend it back to the vertical axis ($X = 0$).

**(b)** Gradient, using two points far apart on the line, $(1,\,7.19)$ and $(6,\,13.21)$:

$$m = \frac{13.21 - 7.19}{6 - 1} = \frac{6.02}{5} \approx 1.2 \approx 1 \ \text{(nearest whole number)}.$$

Intercept on the vertical axis ($X = 0$): going back one unit from $(1,\,7.19)$ with gradient $1.2$ gives $c = 7.19 - 1.2 \approx 6.0 \approx 6$.

A least-squares fit of the six points gives $10^Y = 1.203X + 5.988$, which confirms the graphical values.

$$\boxed{m \approx 1,\qquad c \approx 6}$$

Check: with $m = 1.2$ and $c = 6$ exactly, $X = 3$ gives $\log_{10}(9.6) = 0.982$ and $X = 6$ gives $\log_{10}(13.2) = 1.121$, matching the table. To the nearest whole number the answers are $m = 1$ and $c = 6$.
